headline: Israel continues holding 48 Gaza prisoners who completed their sentences commission reports
label: NEWS
caption:
At least 48 Palestinian prisoners from Gaza remain locked up in Israeli custody despite completing their full prison sentences 🇵🇸

According to the Palestinian Commission of Detainees and Ex Detainees Affairs, dozens of Gaza detainees are still held after their prison terms expired.

Families in Gaza say they expected long awaited reunions after sentence terms ended, only to learn their relatives remain in custody under Israeli legal classifications.

The UN Human Rights Office verified the de@ths of at least 92 Palestinians in Israeli custody since October 2023 amid reported worsening prison conditions.
